question: What do infantry bullets do to each vehicle class in the material grid, and does the grid hold the 'damage table' that ROSTER_VALUES.md suspected behind the Improved Armor passive?

sourceFacts.method: For the 19 infantry bullet materials and four vehicle gun materials, every scalar record (Class_d4177d69.Field_674633de) against helicopter (121), jet (120), armour (119), light vehicle (122, 187) target materials was read in two level grids with its record key (smallarms.py). The Improved Armor affector file was decoded and its packed material read (upper 12 bits = material ID), and the same bullets were read against that material.

control.description: Both level grids agree on every record. Vehicle target cells have no multiplier array (L3363 check), so the scalar is the value in use; the launcher figures EA states were reproduced from these scalars in L3323.

targets.508: material named by the Improved Armor affector

sourceFacts.uiText: Attack Helicopter Improved Armor: resistance against most infantry weapons (VEHICLE_SITE_ADDITIONS.md)
sourceFacts.ea: 1.3.1.0: Transport Helicopter has Improved Armor by default, reducing the amount of damage taken from small arms fire

inference: No infantry bullet damages tanks, IFVs, armoured transports or anti-air vehicles: grid value 0 for all 19 materials. Only the jet cannon's material has a value there (0.3).
Against jets the values are 0.3 (pistol and PDW bullets), 0.5 (carbine), 0.7 (rifle, DMR, sniper) and 0.8 (machine gun); shotguns 0.

Against helicopters every rifle-calibre and pistol-calibre material holds two records with keys 0 and 2, the second 0.4 higher (0.16 / 0.56, 0.25 / 0.65, 0.4 / 0.8, 0.6 / 1.0). Earlier leads (L3338, L3357) recorded the key 0 value for vehicle machine guns against helicopters; the key 2 value is the alternative. What selects the key is not read.

The Improved Armor affector holds one packed material, ID 508. Against material 508 infantry bullets hold 0.5 (pistol 0.55), vehicle machine guns and miniguns 1.0, and the jet cannon has no record. That fits the UI text 'resistance against most infantry weapons' if 508 is applied as an extra factor; how it combines with the helicopter record is not read.
So the 'damage table' suspected in ROSTER_VALUES.md exists in the grid in two candidate forms (the key 2 record and the material 508 column); stored data does not say which the passive uses.
unresolved: Which helicopter record applies without the passive, and what the passive changes. Test: one assault rifle bullet (known damage at that range) on a Scout Helicopter and on an Attack Helicopter with Improved Armor, reading the vehicle health lost each time. A 25-damage bullet gives 10 (0.4), 20 (0.8), 5 (0.4 x 0.5) or 10 (0.8 x 0.5).
The selector for record keys 0 and 2 (an ammunition step, a vehicle state, or the passive).
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Small-arms bullets against vehicles: grid values per vehicle class, two keyed records against helicopters, and the material the Improved Armor passive names
leads.summary: Infantry bullets store 0 against armoured vehicles, 0.3 to 0.8 against jets and two keyed values against helicopters (0.16 / 0.56 for pistol calibres up to 0.6 / 1.0 for machine guns). The Improved Armor passive's affector names material 508, against which infantry bullets store 0.5 and vehicle machine guns 1.0. Which helicopter record applies and how the passive combines is left for an in-game reading. 116 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: An in-game damage reading of small arms on a helicopter with and without Improved Armor.
leads.statusNote: Values recorded; selection between the two helicopter records unread.
